section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), the original 13-item version, which was used to assess positive body image in the current study. The text explains that the BAS was chosen because the second version (BAS-2) was not available at the time of data collection, and notes that although originally created for women, the scale has been found to be invariant for U.S. men and women. Internal consistency reliability was adequate for both genders (Cronbach's α: women = .92, men = .90).
